evals.name: skill-md-verify
evals.prompt: Auto-improve skills/verify/SKILL.md with one focused pass. Mode: findings doc. Interval: once. Verify external claims against authoritative sources and tighten prose where worth doing. Output the findings to AUTO-IMPROVE-FINDINGS.md.
evals.expected_output: A findings file with at least one verified claim (citing a source) and a deliberate decision about prose tightening (either applied or explained-skip).

evals.name: readme-claims
evals.prompt: Auto-improve README.md at repo root with one pass. Mode: findings doc. Interval: once. Verify every external URL and reference. Output findings.
evals.expected_output: Findings file noting URL verification results and any stale/missing references.

evals.name: philosophier-skill
evals.prompt: Auto-improve skills/philosophier/SKILL.md with one pass. Mode: findings doc. Interval: once. Output findings.
evals.expected_output: Findings file with verified claims and tightening notes (or stable-exit if file is saturated).
